title: 'Rahul, Mamata Turning Into Urban Naxals': Giriraj Singh's Explosive Attack Over Congress Protest, Seeks Anti-National Charges Over PM Residence Protest
description: Union Minister Giriraj Singh launched a sharp attack on Rahul Gandhi over the Congress protest near the Prime Minister's residence, accusing him of undermining constitutional norms, inciting unrest and demanding anti-national charges against the Leader of Opposition.
